invalid_query: The search filters are not valid.
empty_update: There are no changes to save.
code_taken: A study with that code already exists.
lab_study_not_found: The lab study does not exist.
diagnostic_study_not_found: The diagnostic study does not exist.
study_in_use: That study is already in an order. Deactivate it instead of deleting it.
turn_not_found: There is no ticket with that number today.
turn_without_patient: That ticket has no registered patient. Register them first.
record_not_found: The medical record does not exist.
record_expired: That consultation is from another day: it can no longer be edited. Open a new one.
record_open_today: This patient already has a consultation open today ({folio}). Continue it instead of opening another.
section_unknown: That section does not exist in the medical record.
section_not_available: That section cannot be captured yet.
order_already_charged: That order was already charged at the register. What must be voided is the sale.
order_needs_lines: The order needs at least one line.
no_default_warehouse: You have no assigned warehouse. Ask an administrator to assign one.
study_not_available: One of the studies is no longer available.
import_too_large: The file is larger than the 2 MB limit
import_unreadable: We could not read the file. Is it a valid Excel?
import_empty: The file has no data rows
import_duplicate_code: The code is repeated inside the file
import_invalid_money: The amount is not valid (positive, up to 2 decimals)

pdf.charge_at_register: Pay at the register with this folio.
